Add Pre-extracted Posterior Latents and Evaluation Closures

Source: R/S7-stanfit-postprocess.R
add_posterior_latents.Rd

Extracts and structures draw-level latent parameters (\(m\), \(S\), \(\kappa\), \(\nu\), \(\Sigma_{\text{exp}}\), \(\Sigma_{\text{marg}}\), and lapse rates) and compiles unified likelihood and posterior evaluation closures. Pre-computed outputs are stored strictly in model@cache$draws and model@cache$summary:

  • model@cache$draws: Contains draw-level representations:

    parameters

    A nested tibble of raw posterior draws across iterations/draws, including \(m\), \(S\), \(\kappa\), \(\nu\), \(\Sigma_{\text{exp}}\), \(\Sigma_{\text{marg}}\), and optional lapse_rate.

    likelihood_function

    Closure evaluating draw-wise category likelihoods with model-family predictive densities (NIW: multivariate Student-t; NIX: univariate Student-t; MNIX: independent Student-t).

    posterior_function

    Closure evaluating draw-wise posterior category probabilities.

  • model@cache$summary: Contains point estimates and across-draw summaries:

    parameters

    Point estimates obtained by taking the mean across all posterior draws for each latent parameter (\(m\), \(S\), \(\kappa\), \(\nu\), \(\Sigma_{\text{exp}}\), \(\Sigma_{\text{marg}}\), and lapse_rate) per group and category.

    expected_moments

    Distribution summary table (mean, standard deviation, and quantile credible intervals specified by probs) across posterior draws for the category mean \(\mu\) and expected category covariance \(\Sigma_{\text{exp}} = S / (\nu - D - 1)\).

    marginal_moments

    Distribution summary table across posterior draws for the category mean \(\mu\) and marginal predictive covariance \(\Sigma_{\text{marg}} = \frac{\kappa + 1} {\kappa} \Sigma_{\text{exp}}\).

    likelihood_function

    Closure evaluating category likelihoods from aggregated point estimates.

    posterior_function

    Closure evaluating category posterior probabilities from aggregated point estimates.

Usage

add_posterior_latents(model, probs = c(0.025, 0.5, 0.975), ...)

Arguments

model

An MVBU_Stanfit object.

probs

Numeric vector of probabilities for credible interval quantiles. (default: c(0.025, 0.5, 0.975))

...

Additional arguments passed to get_draws.

Value

The updated MVBU_Stanfit object with pre-extracted latents stored in model@cache$draws and model@cache$summary.

See also

MVBU_Stanfit, get_draws, add_criterion, vignette("fitting-and-working-with-stanfit-models")

Examples

# \donttest{
fit <- example_ideal_adaptor_stanfit()
#> Warning: The largest R-hat is NA, indicating chains have not mixed.
#> Running the chains for more iterations may help. See
#> https://mc-stan.org/misc/warnings.html#r-hat
#> Warning: Bulk Effective Samples Size (ESS) is too low, indicating posterior means and medians may be unreliable.
#> Running the chains for more iterations may help. See
#> https://mc-stan.org/misc/warnings.html#bulk-ess
#> Warning: Tail Effective Samples Size (ESS) is too low, indicating posterior variances and tail quantiles may be unreliable.
#> Running the chains for more iterations may help. See
#> https://mc-stan.org/misc/warnings.html#tail-ess
fit <- add_posterior_latents(fit)
fit
#> <NIW_IdealAdaptorStanfit>
#>   Model family: NIW
#>   Categories (2): /d/, /t/
#>   Cues (1): VOT
#>   Groups (3): no_exposure, left_shifted, right_shifted
#>   Draws: 25
# }
